title: Surreal Underwater Dream
description: A surreal monochrome scene features a cracked female bust emerging from dark water with closed eyes and red tears streaming down. A sea turtle with an ornate shell carries a wild-haired figure on its back, while a purple palm tree with a bleeding smiling face grows from the bust. A green snake coils around the figures. Whales float in a swirling night sky above, surrounded by red poppies and coral.
prompt: Surreal symbolic illustration showing a cracked classical female bust rising from dark water with closed eyes and dripping red tears. A detailed sea turtle with ornate shell carries a wild-haired bespectacled figure and a purple palm tree with a smiling bleeding face. A green snake coils through the composition. Grey whales swim in a swirling starry sky above. Red poppies, coral, and dripping red liquid elements throughout, high contrast black and white with selective red and purple coloring.
